title: Researching Graph-RAG Tax AI Systems & Agentic AI
description: Researched and developed a Graph-RAG system for tax accountants. Designed and built entity ontologies and knowledge graphs to support rich retrieval across complex statutory, case law, and administrative interpretation data. Developed an agentic AI system to answer tax-related questions.

title: Developing Chatbot AI Systems for GGGI
description: Developed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-based Large Language Model (LLM) chatbot.

title: Developing Carbon AI System
description: Developed Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Large Language Models (LLMs) for climate, environmental, and urban applications.

title: Summarizing Precedents using Large Language Models
description: Summarized judicial precedents using deep learning/LLMs to help judges understand cases more easily, as part of a research project with the court.

title: Tight Bounding Boxes for Shape Decomposition
description: Split 3D meshes into small partitions and merged the partitions using a criterion that induces tight bounding boxes. Refined the boxes using MCTS to tighten them by fixing errors.

title: High-Frequency Trading Strategy using Order Book
description: Researched high-frequency trading strategies using deep learning with cryptocurrency order book data.

title: Long Term Video Prediction
description: Investigated the frame collapse problem in long-term video generation. Based on SRVP, explored approaches including VQVAE, Temporal Abstraction, and Adversarial Training to mitigate error accumulation in the latent vector, a common problem in auto-regressive models.
